description: Web distribution of the stage-A conditional attributes (employment status, position, industry). graph.json schema_version 3 adds graph.emp; the page recomputes municipality blocks and fetches aggregated blocks.

graph.emp.version: model version of employment_a.npz (must equal graph model_version)
graph.emp.pref_of_muni: prefecture index per graph.munis entry (-1 for aggregated-ward cities)
graph.emp.leaf_index: row index into employment_inputs.bin per graph.munis entry (-1 for aggregated-ward cities)
graph.emp.pk_e: base64 float32 [2,13,8,4] national P(status|education,sex,age) for K1..K4 (ESS 04000 by status)
graph.emp.pg: base64 float32 [47,2,2,13,4,20] prefecture P(industry|status,sex,age) for graduates/enrolled (ESS 10-1, shrink 300 toward national)
graph.emp.tilt: base64 float32 [2,4,20,16] industry income tilt relative to the status total (ESS 24, national, no age)
graph.emp.cp: base64 float32 [47,2,13,4,16] prefecture status income shapes r(y|p,s,a,k)
graph.emp.pu_e: base64 float32 [47,2,13,8] prefecture P(unemployed | not employed, education) (census 12-1, shrink 100)

employment_inputs.bin.row: leaf municipality (leaf_index order) x sex x age band
columns: G01..G20 employed persons by industry scaled to model employed persons

page_computation: For a leaf municipality x sex x age the page rebuilds the 8x17 education x income-component table with the education IPF, splits the zero-income component into family workers / not employed (IPF with education-specific employment rate seed), splits not employed into unemployed / not in labour force (IPF with pu_e seed), forms the paid seed R(e) P(k|e) P(g|k,e) P(y|k,g) and runs the 3-margin IPF (education x income, status, industry) to relative tolerance 1e-6. Verified against Python by tests/web_employment_check.cjs.
